title: Reversing vehicle, no banksman

hazards.description: Rigid vehicle is reversing toward the camera along x=3.0: its rear plane moves from 4.45 m out to 3.20 m out over the first 7 s. The worker enters that corridor at 3.6 m and walks into the swept line, so contact lands at about 7.0 s. No banksman is in shot and the reversing path is not barricaded, so nothing breaks the sequence.

notes: Rear-sight blind zone; audit-relevant because segregation is absent.
